topics.title: Arabon ke Mazaahib

paragraphs.text: [Topic ke shuru ka matn mojood nahin — text darmiyan-e-paragraph se shuru hota hai] ...gaaon. Yahudiyat ne Islam se pehle ki siyasi zindagi mein ek ahem kirdaar ada kiya. Jab us sarzameen par Islam ka sooraj tulu hua, to wahan pehle se hi kai mashhoor Yahudi qabail mojood the — Khaibar, Al-Mustaliq, An-Nadeer, Quraizah aur Qainuqa'. Baaz riwayaton mein Yahudi qabail ki tadaad bees (20) tak batayi gayi hai.

Yahudiyat ko Yaman mein As'ad Abi Karb naami shakhs laaya. Woh Yathrib mein jang karne gaya tha aur wahan usne Yahudiyat qubool kar li, phir Bani Quraizah ke do rabbiyon (yahudi aalimon) ko apne saath lekar wapas aaya taake woh Yaman ke logon ko is naye mazhab ki taleem dein. Yahudiyat ko wahan phailne aur maanne wale haasil karne ke liye zarkhez zameen mil gayi. Uski maut ke baad uska beta Yusuf Dhu Nawas iqtidaar mein aaya, usne Najran ki Isaai (Christian) jamaat par hamla kiya aur unhe Yahudiyat qubool karne ka hukm diya. Jab unhone inkaar kiya, to usne hukm diya ke aag se bhari ek khandaq khodi jaaye aur tamam Isaaiyon ko bila tafreeq usmein daal kar jala diya jaaye. Andazon ke mutabiq us insaani qatl-e-aam mein 20-40 hazaar Isaai maare gaye. Qur'an ne us waqia ka kuch hissa Surah Al-Buruj (burjon wali) mein bayan kiya hai.

Isaaiyat ka Arab mein pehli baar zahoor Habashi (Ethiopian) aur Romi nau-aabaadkaron (colonists) ke us mulk mein daakhil hone ke baad hua. Habashi (Ethiopian) nau-aabaadkaari afwaaj ne Isaai mission ke saath milkar Dhu Nawas ke zulmon ke radd-e-amal (intiqaam) ke taur par Yaman mein qadam rakha, aur shiddat se apna aqeeda phailaana shuru kar diya. Unhone ek girja (church) bhi banaya aur use Yamani Al-Ka'bah ka naam diya, jiska maqsad Arab Hajj ke qaafilon ka rukh Yaman ki taraf morna tha, aur phir unhone Makkah mein Baitullah ko maismaar (tabaah) karne ki koshish ki. Lekin Allah, Almighty, ne unhe zaroor saza di aur unhe ibrat ka nishaan bana diya — duniya aur aakhirat dono mein.

Fimion naami ek Isaai mishanri (missionary), jo apne zaahidana (tark-e-dunya wale) tarz-e-amal aur mojze dikhaane ke liye mashhoor tha, isi tarah Najran mein daakhil ho gaya. Wahan usne logon ko Isaaiyat ki taraf bulaaya, aur apni imaandaari aur sachchi lagan ki badaulat woh unhe is baat par aamaada karne mein kaamyaab ho gaya ke woh uski dawat ka musbat jawab dein aur Isaaiyat qubool kar lein.

Jin numaayaan qabail ne Isaaiyat qubool ki un mein Ghassan, Taghlib, Tai' aur kuch Himyari baadshah, neez Romi sltanat ki sarhadon par rehne wale doosre qabail shaamil the. Magoosiyat (Magianism, aatish-parasti) un Arabon mein bhi maqbool thi jo Persia (Iran), Iraq, Bahrain, Al-Ahsa' aur Khaleej-e-Arab (Arabian Gulf) ke saahili ilaqon ke aas-paas rehte the. Kuch Yamani logon ke baare mein bhi bataya jaata hai ke Persian qabze ke dauran unhone Magoosiyat ikhtiyaar ki thi.

Jahan tak Saabiyat (Sabianism) ka taalluq hai, Iraq mein khudaai (excavations) se maaloom hua ke yeh Kaldani logon, Syriyon aur Yamaniyon mein maqbool thi. Lekin Yahudiyat aur Isaaiyat ke aane ke saath, Saabiyat naye mazaahib ke samne pichhe hatne lagi, agarche Iraq aur Khaleej-e-Arab mein Magoosiyon ke saath mile-jule ya un ke qareeb kuch maanne wale uske baaqi rahe.

Islam ke aane se pehle Arabon ki mazhabi zindagi aisi hi thi. Maqbool mazaahib ne jo kirdaar ada kiya woh itna kam-tar tha ke darasal woh na hone ke baraabar tha. Mushrikeen, jo Ibrahimi deen (Abrahamism) ka jhuta daawa karte the, uske usoolon se itne door ja chuke the aur uske batini husn-e-akhlaaq se bilkul be-khabar the. Woh na-farmaani aur khuda-faramoshi mein doob gaye, aur unhone kuch ajeeb mazhabi tawahhumaat (superstitions) ghadh liye jo poore Arab ki mazhabi aur samaaji-siyasi zindagi par sanjeeda asar chhod gaye.

Yahudiyat ghaliba (hegemony) ke saath milkar ek qaabil-e-nafrat munafqat mein badal gayi. Rabbi (yahudi aalim) Rab ko chhod kar khud rab ban baithe. Woh logon ko jabraan apna mutee' banaane aur apne maatehton ko zaraa si baat ya khayaal par jawab-dehi ke liye pakadne mein masroof ho gaye. Unka wahid maqsad daulat aur taaqat haasil karna ban gaya, chaahe iske liye apna mazhab khona pade, ya ilhaad (atheism) aur kufr hi kyun na zahoor mein aaye.

Isaaiyat ne bhi isi tarah shirk ke liye apne darwaze khol diye, aur ek aasmani mazhab ke taur par use samajhna bahut mushkil ho gaya. Mazhabi amal ke taur par, isne insaan aur Khuda ka ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb mila-jula naqsha ghadh liya. Jin Arabon ne ise apnaaya un ki rooh par iska koi asar na hua, sirf is liye ke yeh un ke tarz-e-zindagi se ajnabi tha aur un ki amali zindagi se iska zaraa bhi taalluq na tha.
Doosre mazaahib ke log apne rujhaanaat, aqaaid, rasm-o-riwaaj aur rivaayaat ke aetbaar se mushrikeen hi jaise the.

topics.topicSummary: Islam se pehle ke Arab mein apni ghaalib but-parasti ke saath-saath kai mazaahib mojood the — Yahudiyat (jo As'ad Abi Karb ke zariye Yaman mein aayi aur baad mein siyasi taur par bigad gayi), Isaaiyat (jo Habashi nau-aabaadkaron aur mishanriyon ke zariye phaili, sarhadi qabail ne ise apnaaya), Magoosiyat (jo Persia aur Khaleej ke qareeb maqbool thi) aur Saabiyat (jo qadeem thi magar dam tod rahi thi). Islam ke aane ke waqt tak in mein se kisi mazhab ne koi maani-khez roohani kirdaar ada nahin kiya — sab bigad chuke the, siyasi ho chuke the, ya logon ki asal zindagi se kat chuke the.
keyPoints: Islam ke aaghaaz par Arab mein kai Yahudi qabail mojood the — un mein An-Nadeer, Quraizah aur Qainuqa' shaamil the
Yahudiyat ko Yaman mein As'ad Abi Karb laaya; uske bete Dhu Nawas ne baad mein 20,000–40,000 Isaaiyon ka qatl-e-aam kiya — jiska zikr Surah Al-Buruj mein hai
Isaaiyat Arab mein Habashi aur Romi nau-aabaadkaron ke zariye daakhil hui; Habashiyon ne Arab Hajj ka rukh morne ke liye ek 'Yamani Ka'bah' banayi aur Makkah mein Baitullah ko giraane ki koshish ki
Isaai mishanri Fimion ne apne zaahidana tarz-e-zindagi aur mojzon ke zariye Najran ke logon ko Isaai banaaya
Magoosiyat Persia, Iraq, Bahrain aur Khaleej-e-Arab ke saahil ke qareeb maqbool thi
Saabiyat qadeem thi magar Yahudiyat aur Isaaiyat ke uruuj ke saath dam tod gayi

Islam ke aane tak: mushrikeen Ibrahimi deen ko bigad chuke the, Yahudi munafqat aur taaqat ki talab ki taraf mud gaye the, aur Isaaiyat shirk ke saath gad-mad ho chuki thi — tamam mazaahib apna asal roohani asar kho chuke the

quiz.question: Yahudiyat ko Yaman mein kaun laaya?
Najran mein Dhu Nawas ke qatl-e-aam mein andaazan kitne Isaai maare gaye the?
Habashiyon ne Yaman mein kya banaya taake Arab Hajj ka rukh Makkah se hata diya jaaye?
options: Dar Al-Malik naami ek azeem mahal
Ek girja jise unhone Yamani Al-Ka'bah kaha
Isaai Khuda ke liye ek maqdis (mandir)
Hajj ke qaafilon ko aakarshit karne ke liye ek tijaarti markaz
quiz.answer: Ek girja jise unhone Yamani Al-Ka'bah kaha

quiz.question: Darj-zail mein se kaun se qabail un numaayaan qabail mein shaamil the jinhone Isaaiyat qubool ki?
Matn ke mutabiq, Islam se pehle ke Arab ke daur tak Yahudiyat kis cheez mein bigad chuki thi?
options: Ek khaalis roohani aur zaahidana amal
Ghaliba ke saath mili hui qaabil-e-nafrat munafqat, jahan rabbi daulat aur taaqat ki talab mein the
Habashi sltanat ke saath ek fauji ittehaad
Arab but-parasti ke saath ek pur-aman saath-saath rehna
quiz.answer: Ghaliba ke saath mili hui qaabil-e-nafrat munafqat, jahan rabbi daulat aur taaqat ki talab mein the
